project_type: React SPA with Vite bundler and Tailwind CSS v4
build_system: Vite - scripts in package.json: dev, build, lint, preview
test_framework: No test framework configured - validation is via build and lint
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to confirm no compilation errors. 2. Run npm run lint to confirm no lint errors.
environment_constraints: Open internet available. Node.js runtime expected to be installed.
contribution_requirements: Branch from current branch (stage-6-analytics-reporting-engine), create new branch stage-7-settings-configuration, commit all changes.
key_patterns: 1. Pages use tab navigation with TABS array, activeTab state, pill-style tab buttons. 2. Each page imports sub-components from src/components/featurename/ folder. 3. Sidebar uses NAV_ITEMS array with lucide icons and NavLink. 4. App.jsx has flat Route declarations inside a Layout wrapper. 5. localStorage persistence via src/lib/storage.js using getData/setData with STORAGE_PREFIX. 6. Seed data in src/data/seed*.js files exported as functions. 7. AppContext provides global state with get/save/update patterns per entity. 8. Brand color is #5B2D8E (purple). 9. @dnd-kit already installed for drag-and-drop functionality.
directory_structure: src/pages/ - page-level components with tab navigation. src/components/ - feature folders (analytics/, placements/, etc.). src/data/ - seed data files (seedNurses.js, seedFacilities.js, etc.). src/lib/ - utility modules (storage.js). src/context/ - AppContext.jsx global state. src/hooks/ - custom hooks.
